thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: page fired: GPU memory pressure detected in cluster-redwood-prod-gpu-1. Alert summary: cuda memory error / OOMs observed on inference pods serving embed-quant-v2. PagerDuty incident: I-2026-ACME-1

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert -> Triggered: High urgency. Service: redwood-inference-prod-gpu. Escalation policy: oncall-sre -> maya. Alert details: 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 6.2GB' repeated across 3 pods.

maya (oncall): acking. I see the page. Pulling up logs and topology. @alex if you're around can you help with routing?

sam: on standby. saw similar spike for another customer earlier today, might be related to increased batch sizes from embeddings job.

maya (oncall): quick findings: 3 pods in ns=redwood-inference, deployment=embed-quant-v2 show OOM/CrashLoopBackOff. Node gpu-12 shows high memory reserved. Attaching recent kube logs:
```
kubectl -n redwood-inference get pods -o wide
embed-quant-v2-5f6d8   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff   3   2m   10.0.1.34   gpu-12
embed-quant-v2-6a2d1   0/1 OOMKilled          2   5m   10.0.1.35   gpu-12
embed-quant-v2-9b3a0   1/1 Running           0   20m  10.0.2.11   gpu-08
```
and container logs show: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 6200000000 bytes` right after a large batch request.

eng-runtime: likely cause: a sudden large batch / retry storm hitting embed endpoint (client-side) combined with recent quantization changes that slightly increased memory footprint. We should reduce max_batch_size and enable prefix/KV cache eviction for embed-quant-v2 as a quick mitigation.

maya (oncall): mitigation plan (short term):
- scale deployment replicas=0->1 on healthy node (gpu-08) to restore capacity for a small percentage of traffic.
- apply patch: env MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=2048 -> 1024 and set REQUEST_CONCURRENCY=1 for embed-quant-v2.
- route heavy customers to embed-quant-lowmem variant.
- restart crashed pods after config change.

alex: doing the routing now. Pushing a temporary route rule to envoy: route /v1/embeddings from acme-corp -> embed-quant-lowmem.

ops-bot: Runbook step executed: isolation: cordon node gpu-12 to prevent additional pods from landing. `kubectl cordon gpu-12` -> succeeded.

sam: applying config patch to deployment: `kubectl -n redwood-inference set env deployment/embed-quant-v2 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=1024 REQUEST_CONCURRENCY=1`

maya (oncall): restarting crashloop pods after env update.
```
kubectl -n redwood-inference rollout restart deployment/embed-quant-v2
kubectl -n redwood-inference get pods -w | grep embed-quant-v2
```

eng-runtime: observed new pods coming up on gpu-08, memory stable, no further OOMs in last 3m. Metrics: GPU memory utilization dropped from 92% -> 68% after patch and reroute.

product-support: customer-impact check: preliminary: acme-corp (priority) saw ~12 failed embedding requests between 14:02-14:10 UTC, retries caused higher load. No data loss; responses were 500 for those requests. CS notified account owner and opened support ticket TKT-7891.

maya (oncall): that's consistent with the logs. Marking incident severity P2 for now. Will keep P1 if more customers impacted.

alex: I've left a temporary traffic rule in place and started gradual rollback of heavy batching features for embed route. Notifying infra to keep gpu-12 cordoned until we confirm node health.

sam: monitoring heuristics: adding a short-term alert to watch for `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` occurrences > 1/min and GPU mem > 85% across the cluster.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4622 (auto-created)

maya (oncall): handoff notes for next oncall (alex):
- incident I-2026-ACME-1: mitigations applied: reduced batch tokens, lowered concurrency, routed high-volume tenants to lowmem model, cordoned gpu-12.
- current status: embed-quant-v2 stable on gpu-08, no new OOMs in last 6m, monitoring active.
- action items: follow up with infra to run node diagnostics on gpu-12 and consider memory reclaim/driver update; coordinate with product-support for customer postmortem if failures exceed 20 requests.

alex: acked handoff. I'll take the follow-ups. Thanks @maya, @sam. :thumbsup:

product-support: I'll prepare the customer communication draft and attach logs. ETA 30m.

maya (oncall): closing page in PagerDuty. Leaving this thread for postmortem notes. If OOMs recur, re-open and escalate to eng-sre.

pagerduty: Incident I-2026-ACME-1 -> Resolved (ack and mitigation applied). Duration: ~12 minutes.

ops-bot: Reminder: add runbook augmentation: include a throttle rule for batch size spikes and explicit node-level GPU health checks.

eng-runtime: planning follow-up: reproduce memory regression with latest quantization build in staging, and add a canary gate before rollout.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. End of thread. :white_check_mark:
